{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# First, filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify deduplication
print(f'After deduplication, patient_id count: {df_dedup["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Original patient_id count: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check that the deduplication reduced the row count by 48 (24 patients retested)
print(f'Rows removed by deduplication: {len(df) - len(df_dedup)}')"}
